notes.title: 65k Wishlists and Our First Game Awards Nominations
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there, 

It’s hard to put into words the feeling that we’ve all shared ever since we revealed PHASE ZERO three months ago. Since our announcement, we’ve received tons and tons of positive comments about our game and our demo was played by thousands of people from all over the world (shout out to the one person from Curacao who played the demo!). And to see that we’ve reached over 65,000 Steam Wishlists in just under three months is… nuts. So thank you to all of you who played our demo, left us comments, for the Overwhelmingly Positive demo rating, for joining our [url="https://discord.gg/6MB8esN8Rn"]Discord[/url] (come join if you haven’t - it’s fun!), making crazy-cool fan art, and wishlisting our ode to classic survival horror. 

You all are the best.

We also had another pleasant surprise. Last month, PHASE ZERO was nominated in three categories at the PIXEL AWARDS EUROPE (love the capitalised title, just btw). Our game got nominated for the Big Bang!, Retro Roots, and the Indie Grand Prix awards. Unfortunately, we didn’t end up taking any of the award statues home, but just to be mentioned along with other great titles was a reward in itself. And the best part was, on the day we got to show off our game to you, the people! Check out some of the photos from the showfloor. We had a blast.
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539257/fcc16a4f1645d061789f3d1a840d2e177d1251df.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539257/e51db22079580f7634fe979efef0a05b2b19e8fe.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539257/ba205c9d87a81152c9a9a8407b39ebfa824ee255.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539257/61da7f148cbcd4f9cfd1db2fada8e5e635888760.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p]
So, what’s coming up next for us? To be honest, lots and lots of work. We will now bury our heads deep and keep working on PHASE ZERO. We have some new tasty locations to cook, new zombies and enemies to make, and lots of other things that are both big and small, and somewhere in between. Our plan is to share with you what we are working on here on Steam, so follow our game or join our [url="https://discord.gg/6MB8esN8Rn"]Discord[/url] so you can stay up to date with all the gossip. 

Alright, that’s it from us. Once again, thank you for all your support. It means a ton to us. And as always, stay safe out there people. The streets of Flint Peak are not what they used to be.

Until next time, 
SPINA Studio[/p][p] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472400/PHASE_ZERO_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update #1
Survive the First Hour of the Outbreak – PHASE ZERO Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The wait is over.

[b]The PHASE ZERO demo is now live on Steam[/b] as part of the Zombies vs. Vampires event! Step into the snowy nightmare of Flint Peak and experience the first 30-40 minutes of our take on the classic survival horror.

In the demo, you’ll play as Guy, a mechanical engineer who wakes up in a hospital just as the grotesque outbreak begins to tear the town apart. The first night of the outbreak begins. Can you survive till dawn?

We’ve also released a [b]10-minute gameplay video with developer commentary[/b] exclusively on IGN. So if you want to see a little behind-the-scenes look at how PHASE ZERO plays, watch the video below.

[previewyoutube=zaBW-TG4Ha8;full][/previewyoutube]
Last but not least, if you have any feedback, suggestions, or thoughts about the PHASE ZERO demo, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/6MB8esN8Rn]Discord server[/url]. We’d love to hear your thoughts.

Download the demo now, load up that shotgun, and prepare for a chillingly good time.

Good luck and stay safe,

SPINA Studio

notes.title: A massive thanks from us to you
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We just wanted to write a few words to you all and say “Thank you” for all your support. Since last week’s reveal during The MIX, we got tons of positive comments, questions, messages of support, and just general excitement for our game. And we’ve also hit a major goal - we now reached over 10,000 Steam Wishlists in less than a week. To us, this is insane. A wow moment that we’re experiencing live and not just in our imagination. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539257/165245440c96d13c10ef6694eeaf7cab43a97aa8.jpg[/img]

We’ve been working on PHASE ZERO for a while and never did we expect to see such a reaction. So thank you so so much for showing interest in our project. 

Also, a demo is coming real soon too, along with an official Discord server. To have the demo out and in your hands will be another insane moment for us. We hope that you will like it as well. It’s not that far away, so please stay tuned.

Once again, thanks for all your support. We’re making PHASE ZERO just for you. 


Stay safe,  

SPINA Studio

notes.title: Welcome to Flint Peak – PHASE ZERO Reveal Trailer!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Big news! [b]PHASE ZERO Release Trailer[/b] just premiered during the MIX Spring Showcase. That also means that we can finally announce our game with the world too, which in itself is really damn exciting. But first, let's watch the trailer in case you missed it:

[previewyoutube=a1h-GV6rfgc;full][/previewyoutube]

So here it is, our debut game. PHASE ZERO. What’s it about? Well, let us set the scene first. 

It’s 1994. You’re in Flint Peak, an isolated harbor town that feels off. A mysterious illness is spreading fast, twisting its victims into grotesque nightmares. In the midst of the chaos, two survivors - Mary, a reporter fresh to town, and Guy, an injured engineer - must fight to make it through the night. Their only weapons? Whatever they can scavenge. Their only hope? Unraveling the truth before sunrise. Sounds intriguing?

We hope you enjoy the release trailer! If you like what you see, Wishlist PHASE ZERO on Steam right now. Especially since a playable [b]demo is coming soon[/b].


Stay safe,

SPINA Studio
